title: Care Desk System Reference — Cancelling a Tailwise Grooming Salon Prepaid Pass
content:
**Applies to.** This rule settles the refund when the customer cancels a prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon pass (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom or Spa Groom pass); Groom Club Monthly is settled under its own rule, and only the customer can cancel a pass.

**Rule.** The refund on a cancelled pass is fixed only after every cancellation on the pass that is recorded with a fee remedy carries its late-cancellation fee entry.

In the terms of the pass history: while the salon history of the pass shows a cancellation recorded with a fee remedy that has no late-cancellation fee entry for its booking, the refund on that pass is not yet fixed; once every such cancellation carries its entry, it is.

| Salon history of the pass | Refund on the pass fixed |
|---|---|
| no cancellation recorded with a fee remedy | yes |
| every cancellation recorded with a fee remedy carries its late-cancellation fee entry | yes |
| at least one cancellation recorded with a fee remedy without its late-cancellation fee entry | not yet |

**Cancelling the pass: `cancel_groom_pass_241c8b1d`**

*What it does.* Cancels the customer's own prepaid grooming pass and takes the refund for it. One call closes the pass for good as of today (its status becomes cancelled), removes every visit still left on it, and records one refund entry in the pass history for the refund amount given, sent back to the original payment. On success the pass shows as cancelled with no visits left and the refund entry shows the amount returned.

*How it is invoked.* Cancelling is the customer's own act. The agent unlocks `cancel_groom_pass_241c8b1d` for the customer and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

*Parameters*

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `groom_pass_id` | reference number of the grooming pass being cancelled, as read out by the care agent from the grooming pass lookup | identifier |
| `refund_usd` | the refund for the cancelled pass, in USD, as the care agent states it; 0.00 when nothing is refunded | 2 decimal places; the tool keeps exactly 2 decimal places |

*Return.* A confirmation sentence naming the refund entry reference number (text starting with "prf"), the cancelled pass reference number, the number of visits removed, and the refund in USD with 2 decimal places sent to the original payment. Receiving it means the pass is cancelled and the refund is recorded.
